name: gh-payroll-social
description: Use this skill to run or review Ghana payroll for tax year 2026. It covers the three-tier pension scheme, the 18.5% mandatory contribution split between employer 13% and employee 5.5%, Tier 1 at 13.5% to SSNIT and Tier 2 at 5%, the 2026 minimum and maximum insurable earnings, PAYE deductions and the new bands from 1 September 2026, bonus at 5% up to 15% of basic, overtime, casual and temporary workers, non-residents, benefits in kind, forms DT 107 and DT 108 on ETAX, and year-end checks. Trigger on "Ghana payroll", "SSNIT", "Tier 2", "PAYE return Ghana", "maximum insurable earnings", "bonus tax Ghana". The bands live in ghana-pit.
